dataList.title:
The Great Lake of U Corp.
U公司 大湖
dataList.teller:
Whale of the Porous Hand Mermaid
穴掌鲸 人鱼
dataList.content:
… Screech!
……叽！

Huff... Huff...
哈啊……哈啊……

How... many... left...?
还……剩下……几只……

None.
全收拾掉了。

Then this is the last one.
那么这就是最后一只了。

There was something off about those... 'Mermaids' that crawled out of that Whale.
我能从那些鲸中出现的……被称作“人鱼”的东西身上，感受到一股违和感。

A feeling not so different from looking at an Abnormality or a Distortion.
和面对异想体或是扭曲的时候很像。

<Mermaids... were they human, once?>
<这些人鱼……难道都曾是人类吗？>

I guess I should've explained better...
我可能没有解释清楚……

Not every creature that lives in the depths of the Great Lake are called 'Whales'. Whales specifically refer to...
并不是湖中的一切生物都是“鲸”。“鲸”是……

... everything in the Great Lake that can parasitize humans.
……湖中以人类为宿主的生物的统称。

And Whales give birth to 'Mermaids'.
鲸又诞下“人鱼”。

<… And where do the Mermaids come from?>
<……这些人是怎么变成人鱼的？>

They're people devoured by Whales that came with the Waves. There's no guarantee that we won't meet the same fate.
他们被乘浪而来的鲸吞掉了。我们说不定也会那样。

See? Now you know why you could turn the clock all day and fail to bring us back.
明白了吗？也许就算经理您倒转时钟也无济于事。

I see now.
我理解了。

The Waves will be unrelenting, unabating...
此后浪潮依然会波涛汹涌，滚滚而来……

And Ishmael, who'd already weathered and braved these endless, crashing Waves…
而早已承受过数次那毁灭一切的浪潮，又存活下来的以实玛利……

... Was starting to snap, strand by strand.
正一点点的，逐渐走向崩溃。

I have... a mission that I can't fail...
我有……一个必须达成的目标……

And I'll kill everything that stands in my way...
我要把碍事的东西……全部……清除……

Even if I were to stumble, even if every part of me were to fall apart... I'll see it through to the end.
即便背道而驰，坠入深渊，直至破碎……也必须要达成。

Determined and ferocious. Both good attitudes to have when setting sail on an adventure.
执念与决心。作为旅途的起点也不算坏。

Because our voyage is just getting started.
我们真正的航旅才刚刚开始。
